units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 7:7">Ib. 7</cite> <he>ו׳ חדש</he> roses of the new crop. Y.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 7:7">ib.</cite> beg. 37ᵇ <he>עיקר הו׳</he> the rose-tree itself (the wood); Tosef. ib. V, 7 <cite ref="H01611"><he>חרוב</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 14:4">Sabb. XIV, 4</cite> <he>שמן ו׳</he> rose-oil; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 5:7:4">Y. Kil. V, end, 30ᵃ</cite> <he>הקנים והאגין והוו׳ וכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 3:15">Tosef. ib. III, 15</cite> <he>והזורד</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>והוזרד</he>); <cite ref="Eruvin 34b">Erub. 34ᵇ</cite> Ms. M. <he>והאורדין</he> (Rashi <he>והעוזרדין</he>, ed. omitted; corr. acc. or plur.).—Pl. <he>וְרָדִים</he>, <he>וְרָדִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 2:5">Maasr. II, 5</cite> <he>גינת ו׳</he> rose-garden (for the cultivation of fine fruits &c.).

<cite ref="Ketubot 72b:4">Keth. 72ᵇ</cite> <he>טווה ו׳ כנגד פניה</he> she spins red material holding it up to her face (to make it look bright; Tosaf.); [Maim.: she spins in the street <he>וּיֶ׳</he> with a rose in her hair; Rashi (who seems to read <cite ref="F00084"><he>וְרָד</he></cite> fr. <he>רדד</he>): with the thread in front of her body, i.e. she spins in the street in an indecent position.]
